use_case: 개인 기억 앱의 앱 아이콘 마스터 콘셉트

scene.environment: opaque neutral canvas for one isolated centered app-icon mark
scene.atmosphere: quiet product-first graphic study with one dominant symbol

subjects.description: single star-shaped memory mark enclosing one folded-paper component
subjects.scale: centered mark fills roughly 80% of the square canvas
subjects.action: static core metaphor with no secondary objects
subjects.appearance: midnight navy base, warm pale-yellow focal plane, one restrained blue secondary plane

composition.framing: one dominant centered mark filling roughly 80% of the square
composition.viewpoint: front-facing orthographic projection of the square canvas
composition.camera_angle: straight-on and parallel to the canvas, with no tilt or perspective distortion
composition.balance: one dominant centered mark with even breathing room on all sides
depth_layers: core metaphor color plane and geometry
optional restrained secondary plane for depth

lighting.key_quality: crisp controlled edges with restrained dimensional shading
lighting.fill_description: opaque planes retain their specified colors without glare
lighting.shadow_character: small controlled contact shadow only where it clarifies the core geometry
lighting.exposure: strong value contrast preserves the 32px silhouette

color.harmony: deep navy, warm pale yellow, and one restrained blue plane
color.contrast: clear value separation between the centered mark and opaque background
color.saturation: controlled graphic saturation with no decorative color noise

surfaces.micro_detail: crisp component edges and no texture that breaks the silhouette
surfaces.light_response: controlled flat-to-soft shading that preserves the main shape

required_elements: one core metaphor and component geometry derived from the product purpose
